dashboard.heroSubtitle: 13 features for format conversion, PDF editing, document standardization and more

status.title: Usage Statistics
status.description: Module call counts and website visitor analytics
status.noData: No data yet. Click below to generate sample data.

properties.title: Office Document Properties
properties.description: Modify creation time, modification time, creator, and last modifier for .docx / .xlsx / .pptx files
properties.unifiedTime: Unified Time (set created and modified to the same value)
properties.separateTime: Separate Time (set created and modified independently)
properties.creator: Creator

img2pdf.title: Images to PDF
img2pdf.description: Merge PNG / JPEG / TIFF images into a single PDF with drag-and-drop ordering

printSplit.title: PDF Print Split
printSplit.description: Split a multi-page PDF into batches with configurable page count and interval

pdfEditor.title: PDF Page Editor
pdfEditor.description: Delete pages, insert pages from another PDF, or reorder pages
pdfEditor.insertPagesHint: Leave empty to insert all pages, or use commas: 1,3
pdfEditor.atPositionHint: Insert after page N (0 = at beginning)
pdfEditor.clickToSelect: Click page cards to select for deletion
pdfEditor.insertFileRequired: Please select a PDF to insert from

excelMerge.title: Excel Merge
excelMerge.description: Merge multiple .xlsx / .csv files with the same structure into one spreadsheet. All files must have identical column headers.
excelMerge.needMoreFiles: Please select at least 2 Excel files to merge

pdf2img.title: PDF to Images
pdf2img.description: Convert each page of a PDF into individual images, downloaded as a ZIP archive
pdf2img.pagesHint: Leave empty to convert all pages, or use commas: 1,3,5

md2docx.description: Convert Markdown documents to GB/T 9704-2012 compliant Chinese official documents
md2docx.placeholder: Enter Markdown content here, or upload a .md file...
md2docx.emptyTitle: Enter Markdown content on the left
md2docx.emptyHint: Document preview will appear here in real-time
md2docx.privacy: Uploaded files and conversion results are deleted immediately after download

format.description: Reformat existing DOCX files to GB/T 9704-2012 official document standards
format.docxFormats: Upload a .docx file to apply GB/T 9704-2012 formatting

pdfToText.title: PDF to Text
pdfToText.description: Extract text content from PDF files using pdfminer, with optional page range

pdfMerge.title: PDF Merge
pdfMerge.description: Combine multiple PDF files into a single PDF with drag-and-drop ordering

pdfCompress.title: PDF Compress
pdfCompress.description: Reduce PDF file size with three compression levels

metadataClean.title: Metadata Cleaner
metadataClean.description: Strip all metadata from Office documents and PDFs (author, revision history, etc.)

pageDecorate.title: Page Numbers / Headers / Footers
pageDecorate.description: Add page numbers, headers, or footers to PDF pages

pdf-tools.title: Adjust PDF
pdf-tools.description: PDF to text, compress, add page numbers headers footers

rssDetect.title: RSS Feed Detector
rssDetect.description: Enter a website URL to discover RSS/Atom feeds

webpToJpeg.title: WebP to JPEG
webpToJpeg.description: Convert a WebP image to JPEG; transparency is filled with white and animations keep only the first frame
webpToJpeg.hint: Supports .webp, single file, up to 100 MB

pdfRedact.title: PDF Redaction
pdfRedact.description: Upload a PDF, mark sensitive areas with boxes or keyword search, and download a mosaic-redacted copy. The original is never modified.
pdfRedact.hint: .pdf only, up to 100 MB per file. Decrypt password-protected PDFs first.
pdfRedact.drawHint: Drag on the page to mark an area. Select a mark to move or resize it.
pdfRedact.searchTruncated: Too many matches — only the first {n} were returned
pdfRedact.scannedOnly: The pages searched have no text layer (likely scans), so keyword search is unavailable — mark them by hand
pdfRedact.reportVerified: Verified: no text can be extracted from the marked regions
pdfRedact.reportLeftover: Text is still extractable in {n} marked region(s) — please review manually
pdfRedact.irreversible: Redaction is irreversible. Review highly sensitive documents manually after downloading.
pdfRedact.cleaned: Temporary files have been cleaned up.
